title: Spring budding dates gave no clear common positive link to autumn colour in four Japan samples in 1953-2020
abstract: We tested whether earlier ginkgo budding was linked to earlier autumn yellow colour after seasonal temperature controls. Four models used 2,339 paired station-years at 43 Japanese stations in 1953-2020. Models included station-by-reporting-category and year effects. Spring-date slopes ranged from -0.162 to +0.075 days per day. All four primary intervals included zero after correction for four tests. The later southern slope was negative, with a marginal 95% interval of -0.271 to -0.016, but a corrected interval of -0.309 to +0.022. Planned checks did not give a repeated positive link. This does not prove that seasonal carry-over is absent. Seven northern stations, selected long records, missing visit histories, tree changes and coarse temperature limit inference. We do not measure productivity, air pollution or daily extremes. The package gives raw event tables, a matched panel, a verified raw weather rebuild, source hashes, code, all estimates and figures.
